title: Music stinger / UI jingle
description: Short musical cues: level up, quest complete, victory, game over, item found, menu jingles. Stable Audio 3 Small-Music, stereo.
prompt_guide: Name the instrument(s), the gesture and the mood: 'Level up chime, bright ascending harp and bell arpeggio, rewarding fantasy RPG style' - 'Game over sting, slow descending brass, dark and final'. 2-6 seconds.
